_comment: SIZE-TIER extension for `retiree` (2026-10-01): read ONLY by `gen_personas --tier 10k|40k`. Each filler list is APPENDED to the persona's own list of the same name; each template list adds VARIANTS to a structure (new family ids `retiree:<structure>:<k>` after the base variants). Same voice, same invented-content rule; the leak gate runs on every tier build.

event_titles: the bus trip to the abbey

ce_datetime: i have {event_title} {date} at {time}, would you note it down
ce_date_only: would you be good enough to note {event_title} for {date}
ct_dated: would you remind me to {task_title} {date}, please
q_schedule: i should like to know what is in the diary {query_range}
de_named: i'm afraid {event_title} {date} has been called off, please remove it
comp_todo: i have seen to {task_title}, you may cross it off
ue_move: they have changed {event_title} to {time}, would you alter it
and_et: i have {event_title} {date} at {time}, and would you remind me to {task_title2}
